name: qa_sdswap_save
title: OS-FINALQA, Global (OS-SDSWAP): the card pulled in the middle of a save. The project in RAM keeps playing and editing; the save ends with a clear failure (SAVE ... FAILED: NO CARD) and is never continued onto the card put back. Needs a card in the unit (--expect-volume is optional): the save writes a project folder on it, as save_test_card does. A person pulls the card; the timing is the person's, so the failure step is soft

steps.say: OS-SDSWAP, row QA-GLB-011 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md. THIS SCENARIO NEEDS A PERSON and WRITES to the test card (a new project folder under Projects/). After 'PULL THE CARD' take it out of the slot right away (the save takes a second or two: have a finger on it). The project plays during all of it

steps.note: a card is in the unit, not write protected, or nothing below runs
the project plays through the swap

steps.say: SAVING now (F5 SAVE AS): PULL THE CARD within two seconds

steps.note: QA-GLB-011: the card left and the Tracker let it go
QA-GLB-011: the save ended with a clear failure (soft: a save that had already finished says DONE, and the message then is CARD_REMOVED only)
QA-GLB-011: the project in RAM went on playing

steps.say: PUT THE CARD BACK now. The failed save must not continue onto it

steps.note: QA-GLB-011: nothing was saved or retried by itself after the card came back (no new SAVE message)
